logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the B verification memo on WO-01 (water-pump module selection for a water-reclamation transfer loop). A clean horizontal or vertical bar chart showing measured energy in kWh per common pumping acceptance run for all four candidates: P2 = 12 kWh, P3 = 52 kWh, P1 = 56 kWh, P4 = 58 kWh. The P2 bar is highlighted in the report accent color; the other bars are neutral gray. A dashed reference line marks the next-best value (52 kWh, P3) with an annotation "next-best = 52 kWh" and a gap label of 40 kWh between the leader and the field. A caption-style annotation states that all four candidates qualify (quality at least 80, defects at most 5), so selection reduces to lowest energy. Axis labeled "kWh per run" with gridlines every 10 kWh from 0 to 60. No JavaScript, no external resources, no validation tag text. Purpose: let a client reader verify the energy gap visually against the trusted table.
